info.title: Setu API
info.description: Control-plane REST API for single-binary web apps

get.summary:
The next undelivered command for this server (200), or 204 when none
arrives within the wait window. The poll subscribes to the
[`crate::notifier::Notifier`] BEFORE it checks the queue, then sleeps
until a `setu_commands` notification for this server (or the 5 s
fallback tick) and checks again, so an enqueue racing the check is
never missed. Delivery marks the command delivered; a new agent
`boot_id` requeues delivered commands (spec §5). More than 600 polls
per server per minute is 429.

204.description: No command within the wait window

post.summary:
Report a command result; unblocks the `DbAgentClient::call` waiting on
it. Scoped to the authed server: a command owned by another server is
404, so agents cannot complete each other's commands. Unknown ids are
404; a body id that disagrees with the path is a 400 (the path is
authoritative). Repeat posts are an ok idempotent no-op (first writer
wins, no overwrite — see `complete_for`).

Heartbeat: marks the server `online` and stores the metrics batch
(the repo upserts both atomically).

Redeem a single-use join token (`JoinRequest` → `JoinResponse`). A
spent, unknown or expired token is 401 from the repo; the join marks
the server `online`.

get.summary: List catalogue apps (viewer and above).

post.summary: Publish a version from pasted TOML or a URL (operator and above).

Validate pasted TOML without storing it (operator and above). Always
200: validity is in the body (`ok` + `errors`).

get.summary: One app's versions, newest first (viewer and above).

Recent audit rows, newest first (viewer and above — the authz matrix
grants viewers every GET).

post.summary:
Log in: verify the argon2id hash, start a fresh session (a new random
cookie, never the one the request carried: fixation guard) and return
the operator. Failures count per client IP (spec §7, behind Caddy or a
trusted proxy the forwarded address): 10 within 15 minutes → 429.

Log out: destroy the session row and clear the cookie. Anonymous
callers get 401.

get.summary: The current operator, or 401 when anonymous.

All backups, newest first, including those of deleted sites
(`site_id` null; `site_name` and `domain` name them). Viewer and above.

delete.summary:
Delete any backup by id (operator and above), the only way to delete
a `pre_delete` backup once its site is gone: 202 with the same
`delete_backup` job as `DELETE /sites/{id}/backups/{bid}` (on the
site while it exists, else server-level); 409 when already deleted or
queued, or the site has an active job.

get.summary: Recent jobs, newest first (viewer and above).
One job (viewer and above).

Tail a job's log as SSE (viewer and above): the accumulated `jobs.log`
lines first, then — while the job is still `queued`/`running` — new
deltas every 500 ms until it finishes, then an `end` event whose data
is the final status (`done`/`failed`). CR/LF inside a line are
escaped; a `: keep-alive` comment goes out every poll so a gone client
ends the tail; a stream lives at most 30 minutes (then a `reconnect`
event).

200.description: SSE log tail (`data: <line>` events, then `event: end`)

get.summary: The OpenAPI document (viewer and above).
List operators (owner only).

post.summary:
Create an operator (owner only). The password is hashed with argon2id
before storage and never logged.

put.summary:
Change a password: your own (with `current_password`), or anyone's
as the owner. Every session of that operator ends (spec §3); changing
your own starts a fresh session for this browser.

get.summary: List plans (viewer and above).

post.summary: Create a plan (owner only).

get.summary: One plan (viewer and above).
List servers (viewer and above).

post.summary: Register a pending server and mint its join token (operator and above).

get.summary: One server (viewer and above).

delete.summary: Delete a server (operator and above); 409 while sites reference it.

get.summary: Setup status (public, no auth).

post.summary:
Create the owner with the setup token. 401 on a wrong token, 201 once,
409 for everyone once any operator exists.
Register this box as a pending control-plane server (owner only).

get.summary: List sites (viewer and above).

post.summary: Create a site and enqueue its provision job (operator and above).
post.description:
Validates the domain (unique → 409), the app version (must exist and
parse; `image` manifests are rejected with `validation` — phase 2),
the plan (must allow the app) and the server (explicit, or the
online server with the most free memory). Generates the env once,
from the allocated port and short id and the operator-supplied
`prompts`, seals it into the `provisioning` row in the same
transaction, then enqueues `provision_site` (which reads the stored
env and never regenerates it).

get.summary: One site with its latest metric sample (viewer and above).

delete.summary:
Delete the site (operator and above): 202 with a `delete_site` job.
The row disappears when the job finishes; until then `GET` still
finds it (`deleting`). 409 while another job is live.

get.summary: A site's backups, newest first (viewer and above).

post.summary:
Take a manual backup (operator and above): 202 with a `backup_site`
job; the row lands `completed` when the job finishes. 409 while
another job is live for the site.

delete.summary:
Delete a backup's files on its server (operator and above): 202 with a
`delete_backup` job on the site (it serialises with the site's other
jobs); the row ends `deleted` and leaves the list. 409 when the backup
is already deleted, a delete is already queued, or the site has an
active job.

post.summary:
Restore a backup (operator and above): 202 with a `restore_site` job
carrying `payload.backup_id`. The backup must belong to the site.

get.summary:
Masked env list (viewer and above): names plus `secret`/`once`
flags and `has_value`; secret values render as [`MASKED_VALUE`],
never plaintext.

put.summary:
Update non-generated env vars (operator and above): only manifest
entries spelled `value` or `prompt` may change (`generate`/`from`
are derived and rejected with `validation`). Enqueues an
`env_update` job carrying the changes sealed; the job stores them,
rewrites the env file (never with `once` values) and restarts a
running site.

post.summary:
Reveal one env value (operator and above) after re-checking the
caller's password (argon2). Every call is audited: `env.reveal` when
the value is returned, `env.reveal_denied` on a wrong password, with
target `<site id>:<NAME>`. Wrong passwords count toward the login
limiter of the client IP.

get.summary:
Live logs as SSE (viewer and above): `FetchLogs` every 2 s with the
journal cursor of the previous page, so each line renders once as a
`data: <line>` event (CR/LF inside a line escaped). Every poll also
sends a `: keep-alive` comment, so a gone client is noticed (the send
fails, or the channel reports closed) and the agent is no longer
called. The stream ends on disconnect, after an `error` event with a
fixed message when the agent call fails (details are logged), or
with a `reconnect` event after 30 minutes.

post.summary: Restart: stop then start via the runner (operator and above).

Retry a `failed` site: a fresh `provision_site` job from step 1 with
the same allocations and stored env (operator+).
Start the unit (operator and above).
Stop the unit (operator and above).

Update to another published version (operator and above): 202 with an
`update_site` job. 409 while any job is live for the site or the site
is not `running` (the runner would refuse it anyway).

get.summary: Liveness: always 200, no auth, no database.
Readiness: 200 when `SELECT 1` succeeds, 503 otherwise.

site_id.description: `null` once the site is deleted (the backup outlives it).

exec.description:
Path of the executable inside the archive (relative), or the file
name a `binary` download is installed under.

format.description:
What the download is (mirrors the manifest's `format`); absent in
commands from older control planes, which means `tar.gz`.

CommandEnvelope.description:
A command in flight: stable `id` so redelivery is idempotent.
The wire has no delivery counter (ledger R85): the agent dedupes by
id; `agent_commands.attempts` stays a control-plane diagnostic.

CommandResult.description: The agent's report for one command id.

join_token.description:
Single-use join token (valid 1 hour); shown once. Pass it to the
install command as `SETU_JOIN_TOKEN` or on stdin.

value.description: Plaintext for non-secret vars, [`MASKED_VALUE`] for secrets.

EnvVar.description: One concrete env var to write into the site env file.

Heartbeat.description:
Agent heartbeat posted every 15 s. `boot_id` changes whenever the
agent process (or the host) restarts.

JobOut.description:
One job row. `payload` is never rendered (it may carry prompt
answers); poll `log` for progress.

JobResponse.description:
A bare 202 job body (delete: the site row is gone when the job
finishes, so no site is returned).

JoinRequest.description:
First contact: the agent redeems a single-use join token with a
random `nonce` (a retry within 60 s with the same nonce gets the same
server token; another nonce is refused).

JoinResponse.description: Control-plane answer to a join: the long-lived server identity.

Limits.description:
Resource limits for one site (mirrors the manifest `limits.default`;
kept local so the agent needs no manifest dependency).

name.description: Explicit server name; defaults to the machine's hostname.

install_command.description: `setu agent install --control-plane …` for this box (no token).

join_token.description:
Single-use join token (valid 1 hour); shown once. Pass it as
`SETU_JOIN_TOKEN` or on stdin, never on the command line.

toml.description: Pasted manifest TOML. Exactly one of `toml` / `url` is required.

url.description: URL to fetch the manifest from (public hosts only).

RevealOut.description: The plaintext of one env value. Holds a secret: `Debug` redacts it.

cordoned.description: No new sites are placed on a cordoned server.

load1.description: From the latest heartbeat (`null` before the first).

status.description:
Computed on read (spec §3): `pending` until the first join, then
`online` while `last_seen_at` is within 60 s, else `offline`.

current_password.description: Required when changing your own password.

needed.description: True while no operator exists (the wizard must run).

public_url.description: The configured `public_url`, shown by the wizard.

SiteDetailOut.description: `GET /sites/{id}`: the site plus its latest metric sample.

SiteMetricOut.description: The newest 1-minute sample of a site (spec §3 `site_metrics`).

SiteOut.description: One site row (the sealed `env` is never included; see `./env`).

SiteSpec.description:
Everything the agent needs to materialise one site. No paths, no
user, no env file: the agent derives them from `short_id` (spec §4).

UnitState.description: One site unit's state as observed by the agent.

prompts.description:
Answers for `prompt` rules the target version adds (sealed into
the job; existing answers are kept by name).

Workdir.description: The unit's working directory (mirrors the manifest's `run.workdir`).
